paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the ST Token Number C and the accuracy and inference time. The x-axis, labeled “ST Token Number C,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 3 that represent integer values. The y-axis, labeled “Inference time (%)(ms),” is also a linear scale ranging from approximately 34 to 43, with values expressed in both percentage and milliseconds. A blue solid line represents the accuracy, beginning at approximately 42.1% at ST Token Number C=0 and decreasing to approximately 39.1% at ST Token Number C=30. A red solid line represents the inference time, starting at approximately 37.1 ms at ST Token Number C=0 and increasing to approximately 42.3 ms at ST Token Number C=30.
